repo_audit.summary: Signs '/portfolio/balance' without '/trade-api/v2' prefix; fixed in kalshi_engine/kalshi_v2_client.py.
Posts V1 schema to removed POST /portfolio/orders instead of V2 POST /portfolio/events/orders.
Checks market.status === 'settled' (query filter) instead of 'finalized' and never polls ?status=settled.
Renders checkboxes/flags for favorite & longshot strategies that execute zero trades.
Renders lowest $0.01 bids at top instead of [-1] best bid and truncates no_dollars when longer than yes_dollars.
Committed empty (events:[]) in git; legacy main:/ Pages serves empty JSON before browser polling.
Filters result to ['yes','no'] only, dropping finalized binary contracts with result='scalar' ($0.5000).
Previously defaulted KALSHI_DATA_ENV='prod' (external-api.kalshi.com); demo-desk/ serves verified Demo API data directly.
Marks fee formula unverified (ceil_to_cent); official docs specify 6dp rounding + subpenny/cent accumulator.

Prior snapshot had unverified volume_fp on KXGRAMBPS-68-* / KXAAAGASMIN-26DEC31-3.80 / KXXISUCCESSOR-45JAN01-DXUE and mislabeled KXPGATOUR-AUCPBCS26; replaced 100% with verbatim 2026-11-27 API values.
Prior applyFeeAccumulator omitted signed_revenue and produced negative accumulators; replaced with exact BigInt/microdollar 5-step Kalshi fee_rounding + series fee_multiplier.
Scheduled collectors committed data/live & data/account.json without running build-site.mjs, breaking CI/pages.yml HTML freshness gate.
Runs python live/build_page.py without staging live.html in git add, leaving live.html stale after scheduled runs.
Selective feed admitted KXBTCY-27JAN0100-B47500 with $0.97 spread (tightness=0, score=85 >= 60); kalshi_engine & demo-desk enforce hard spread gates.
Live 2026-11-27 Demo /series/KXBTCY returns fee_multiplier=1 (quadratic), whereas Production returns fee_multiplier=0; fees must query active environment.
